limitations.note: The agent correctly fixed the counter enable but also removed `ready_b` from the first-byte load condition, changing `data_out` when a new group starts while downstream is not ready.

The scoreboard assumed every group starts from zero regardless of `ready_b` and checked `data_out` only when a result was pending, so its passing result did not verify preservation of the original accumulator behavior.

The initial knowledge-base query and two empty polls consumed about 20 seconds before the agent listed the notes directly; later, a cleanup command rejected by the shell wrapper forced it to resubmit the simulation command.
